published.text: Model-classified claims (not independently verified): the Workspace Curator Addon computes only classification and briefing, while the MASC host retains durable fact intake, original request identity, memory ledger commits, observer acknowledgements, and effect authority. Within that boundary, keeper_memory_write receipts report a memory-admission request_id plus sequence and persist to the pending_memory_admission store, where Librarian review decides admission; the request_id is not a memory_id and must not be used as a premise or as a supersedes target. Consistent with this division of responsibility, a repaired isolated Curator host completed the originally retained Briefing while the installation was Off, preserved the classification receipt and Keeper memory, and published the matching observer acknowledgement without recreating the worker — showing that disabling the Curator installation preserves pending original work so it can be reattached. Constraints from these claims: disabling must preserve pending original work; re-enabling must keep those original results immutable while processing newly admitted facts separately; and a pending admission candidate must not be rewritten merely because it is not yet visible in search. No conflicts or corrections exist yet; later batches may extend this briefing.
